2206.note: Bianchi's 1876 inventory of the Turin state archive lists Charles Emmanuel I's 1588 instruction to Secretary Corte at Rome 'con altra istruzione in cifra per affari di Stato', with no key or decipherment mentioned and no image online, so it is an open archive-scan lead (mazzo not given).

seen.extent: One instruction (a single item in a miscellany of papers on Rome); mazzo, folios and cipher length not stated by Bianchi.
seen.cipher: Bianchi p. 295 (archive's own inventory): 'Istruzione del Duca al Segretario Corte, mandato a Roma coll'incarico di molte raccomandazioni per benefizi, indulgenze, indulti, ma con altra istruzione in cifra per affari di Stato [1588].' The inventory states the separate state-affairs instruction is in cifra and mentions no key, decipherment or plain copy; the leaf itself has not been seen.

1132.note: The BRAH summary of the Empress's German letter to the Elector Palatine ('largely not deciphered', 1 Mar 1697) matches the Empress's Vienna letter of 27 Feb 1697 (Berlips proposal, queen's remarriage), which the 2023 OeAW edition of Eleonora Magdalena's correspondence (BayHStA Kasten blau 44/7) publishes with its cipher passages read, so it is already read in print.

seen.where: Boletin RAH 96 p. 368 (https://archive.org/details/boletindelareala96madr, djvu text read 5 Nov 2026) and the online edition https://kaiserin-eleonora.oeaw.ac.at/kasten_blau_44_7_0274.xml (Eleonora Magdalena to Johann Wilhelm, Wien 27.02.1697; Bayerisches Hauptstaatsarchiv Muenchen, Kasten blau 44/7), TEI text read 5 Nov 2026.
seen.extent: The edition's letter runs about a page and a half with many cipher passages, tagged unclear reason='chiffriert' and given in plaintext; no ciphertext figures are shown.
seen.cipher: BRAH 96: 'Madrid, 1 de marzo de 1697. La Emperatriz al Elector Palatino. (En aleman, y en gran parte sin descifrar.) St. A. K. bl. 44/y. La sugestion de la Berlips tocante al matrimonio de la Reina si quedase viuda debe quedar en la mayor reserva...'. The edition's 27 Feb 1697 letter reads 'Wegen der Perlips proposition wehr freilich noch zu dissimuliren ... wan man es inen dort aus dem kopf bringen koente', with the cipher words (e.g. 'Pater', 'Prinzes positive resolution') marked chiffriert and deciphered; the edition's overview page also describes how the Empress's cipher was reconstructed ('Dechiffrierung') from contemporary deciphered passages in 44/7. St. A. K. bl. is the Munich Kasten blau series, not Vienna as the lead says.
